brand_context.name: PlaceContext
brand_context.offering: Agentic workflow platform for critical workflows

candidate.central_idea: Two separate paths become one shared path.
candidate.visual_mechanism: Two equal-weight horizontal lines enter from the left at different heights, use short rounded diagonal elbows to merge into a single horizontal output on the right, with the junction deliberately displaced above the center to create a distinctive compact stepped silhouette.
candidate.distinctive_element: An off-center two-to-one junction with equal branch lengths and a long rightward exit.
candidate.shape_logic: precise open geometry, ample negative space
candidate.composition: single centered mark occupying half the square canvas
